fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami-area economic conditions and consumer costs, criticizing Florida Power & Light Company deposit requirements and electric rates and also mentioning the telephone company. Additional pieces discuss high seasonal rents and foreclosure-driven property practices, tourism and seasonal pricing, and local civic/political matters including a satirical letter addressed to Herbert Hoover about federal projects (post office, judge, harbor dredging, Everglades drainage) and prohibition enforcement. Other coverage touches on liquor smuggling routes involving the Bahamas (including Nassau and Bimini), local elections and civic affairs, and assorted columns, letters, and advertisements.
